collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-36  -  THE FAMILY'S SHARED WORK SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Two parents are preparing supper after a tiring day while their children want to help with the household chores.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two parents are preparing supper after a tiring day while their children want to help with the household chores.

choices.label: Give the Older Children Safe, Manageable Tasks.
Invite Everyone to Help According to Their Abilities.
Finish the Most Difficult Work Before Involving the Children.
Simplify the Meal and Rest Together.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children sort vegetables and feel proud of their contribution.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One child becomes frustrated, and a parent patiently demonstrates the task again.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The work is divided fairly without expecting identical contributions.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A family member needs rest, and the others adjust their plans.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The children help arrange the meal once the preparations are safe.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Supper is delayed, but the parents avoid rushing the children into unsuitable tasks.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The family enjoys a modest supper and a peaceful evening.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One parent still feels overwhelmed, and the other offers to handle the remaining cleanup.
